summary: A parent of three children in Montgomery County Public Schools urges the FCC to keep the E‑Rate program but to impose stricter safeguards against digital distraction, including enhanced CIPA enforcement, screen‑time reporting, parental opt‑outs, and AI consent requirements.

claims.requested_action: require parental consent before AI tools are used in schools
claims.argument: AI tools can influence content exposure; parental consent safeguards privacy and autonomy.

claims.requested_action: strengthen enforcement of CIPA and require audits
claims.argument: Digital distraction from unrestricted internet access harms students’ learning, so stricter CIPA enforcement is needed.
